size.description: Number of contracts to buy or sell. For contract size details, refer to the /api/v1/market/instruments endpoint

reduceOnly.description: Whether orders can only reduce in position size.

averagePrice.description: Average filled price. If none is filled, it will return "".

pnl.description: Profit and loss, Applicable to orders which have a trade and aim to close position.

createTime.description: Creation time, Unix timestamp format in milliseconds, e.g. 1597026383085

updateTime.description: Update time, Unix timestamp format in milliseconds, e.g. 1597026383085

tpOrderPrice.description: Take-profit order price. If the price is -1 , take-profit will be executed at the market price.

slOrderPrice.description: Stop-loss order price. If the price is -1 , stop-loss will be executed at the market price.

brokerId.description: Broker ID provided by BloFin. A combination of case-sensitive alphanumerics, all numbers, or all letters of up to 16 characters.
